Mustache pages write `{{value | pipe}}` or `{{value | pipe:arg}}`. Flow YAML templates (`${{ steps.x.outputs.n | pluralize:seat }}`) use the same pipes and chain them left to right. In a mustache page only one pipe applies per tag (`{{x | upper | trim}}` prints x unchanged), `{{{x | pipe}}}` prints nothing, and an unknown pipe name prints the value unchanged. gotmpl pages use Sprig functions instead.

pluralize: the value is a count and the argument names the word. `{{n | pluralize:event}}` → `event` when n is 1, else `events` (the singular plus s); `{{n | pluralize:person,people}}` → `person` / `people`; with no argument it is the suffix only: `{{n}} item{{n | pluralize}}` → `1 item`, `3 items`. A value that isn't a number counts as 0.

cents: multiplies by 100 and rounds to a whole number, dollars to cents for a payment API (`{{amount | cents}}` with 19.99 → `1999`). It is not a money formatter: a cents column shown through it comes out 100 times too large. To show cents as money, divide in SQL (`SELECT price_cents / 100.0 AS price`) and use currency.

currency: `$`, thousands separators, two decimals only when there is a fraction: 2500 → `$2,500`, 25.5 → `$25.50`, -3 → `-$3`. Always dollars. number: the same without `$` (1234567.891 → `1,234,567.89`). percent: the value is already a percentage, one decimal: 12.345 → `12.3%`.

date: parses RFC 3339, `2006-01-02 15:04:05` or `2006-01-02`; default output `Jan 2, 2006`; `date:YYYY-MM-DD` (YYYY, MM and DD are replaced; the rest is a Go layout such as `Jan 2 15:04`); text it can't parse prints unchanged. ago: `just now`, `5 minutes ago`, `yesterday`, `3 weeks ago`, `1 year ago`.

Text: upper, lower, title (capitalize words), trim, truncate:N (first N bytes plus `...` when longer; default 80), slug (`Hello World!` → `hello-world`), initials (`Hello World` → `HW`), first / last (the first / last space-separated word of the text; a list is read as its JSON text, so they don't pick list items), digits (keep 0-9), strip_html (remove tags), default:X (X when the value is empty or missing). nl2br inserts `
`, which `{{ }}` escapes in a page; use CSS `white-space: pre-line` instead.

Data: count / length (items in a list or JSON array; 0 for empty; otherwise commas plus one), json (JSON for lists and maps, the text otherwise; in a <script> it is written as a JSON value), md5 / sha256 (hex), base64, urlencode (query escaping). markdown / markdown_inline render Markdown to sanitized HTML written unescaped in body text. raw and recipients are email markers and change nothing in a page.
